DRY_RUN=""
EXTRA_ARGS=""

# Parse command-line overrides
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --gpu)         GPU="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --data_dir)    DATA_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --output_dir)  OUTPUT_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --model_path)  MODEL_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --batch_size)  BATCH_SIZE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --epochs)      EPOCHS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --lr)          LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --margin_lr)   MARGIN_LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --seed)        SEED="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --dry_run)     DRY_RUN="--dry_run"; shift ;;
        *)             EXTRA_ARGS="$EXTRA_ARGS $1"; shift ;;
    esac

# ----- Environment -----
PROJ_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$PROJ_ROOT"

if [ -f /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate base
fi

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
export HF_HOME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

# ----- Directories -----
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"

# ----- Check model availability -----
if [ ! -d "$MODEL_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Model not found at $MODEL_PATH"
    echo "[INFO] Will download from HuggingFace (microsoft/deberta-v3-large)"
    # Enable network acceleration on AutoDL
    if [ -f /etc/network_turbo ]; then
        source /etc/network_turbo
        export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

    echo "[INFO] Using pre-computed features: $FEATURES_PATH"
    FEAT_FLAG="--features_path $FEATURES_PATH"

    --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --log_dir "$LOG_DIR" \
    --batch_size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
    --epochs "$EPOCHS" \

    --margin_lr "$MARGIN_LR" \

    echo "  Results:    results/dcol/dcol_eval_results.json"

    echo ""
    echo "[DONE] Training complete."
    echo "  Checkpoint: $OUTPUT_DIR/"
fi
